description: This file defines a PHP class 'JsonRPCServerCalls' that implements JSON-RPC server methods such as 'retrieve' and 'query' for interacting with CRM data, including retrieving and querying CRM records, in the context of SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It also includes dependencies and initial access control.

classes.name: JsonRPCServerCalls
classes.description: Class implementing JSON-RPC methods to retrieve and query CRM data records.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a single CRM record as a simplified array structure based on module and record ID.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a query on multiple CRM modules with optional conditions, ordering, and limits, returning a list of records.
